newsitem.title: UK: For Valentine's Day, brand names the key to love.
newsitem.headline: For Valentine's Day, brand names the key to love.

text.p: Money can't buy you love, but according to a British consulting group the right brand-name presents can win the hearts of young lovers on Valentine's Day.
Chanel No. 5 perfume and a subscription to Sky Sports topped the brand-name list of preferred Valentine's presents for Her and Him, according to Interbrand, a London-based brand consultancy firm.
Interbrand's own brand managers compiled the list of preferred brands for young lovers, a spokesman said.

Also on the list of brands sure to win a young woman's heart were: roses from Interflora, La Perla underwear, Louis Vuitton luggage, a flight on the Concorde, Haagen-Dazs ice cream, an MGF car, Cuvee Dom Perignon champagne, a fully expensed Harvey Nichols account card, and Charbonnel et Walker chocolates.

For men, the heart-winning brands also included: a day's racing at Brands Hatch, an American Express Platinum card, Calvin Klein underwear, a Bang & Olufsen stereo, a Sony Playstation, a Harley-Davidson motorcycle, a Tag Heuer watch, Johnnie Walker scotch, and a pair of Ray-Ban sunglasses.
